title: reading first: does list_datasets match a member's translated label from a translation bundle, or only an inline label map
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this seat's chat, 2026-11-17. On the synonyms layer, verbatim: 「同意，所以hotcrm 也需要立卡改进对吧」, answering the seat's three-layer proposal (authors write synonyms; the server hints on a zero-match; the client asks back).

## Why

An app that follows the platform's own convention keeps its Chinese names in a translation bundle. If the term matcher reads only what is written on the dataset itself, a user who types the Chinese name the product shows them on the dashboard still misses the metric.

Who acts: a read-only reading first (server lane, `packages/services/service-analytics`); the build half waits for the reading and, if it widens what counts as a match, for the maintainer.

## Evidence (objectstack `a0326b06`, read 2026-11-17; code read, not run)

- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-term-matcher.ts`: the match targets are the member's `name`, "its `label` in every locale of an inline map", and each of its `synonyms`. `labelTargets` reads `member.label` only.
- Whether the members handed to the matcher already carry bundle translations resolved for the caller's locale was not determined.

## Scope

- Reading: boot an app whose dataset member has a bundle translation and no inline map, call `list_datasets({ terms: [<the translated label>] })` under that locale, and record whether it matches. Post the reading on this card.
- If it does not match: state the options (resolve the caller's locale before matching; match every locale's bundle value; leave it to synonyms) with what each does to ADR-0149 D1/D3, and hand the choice to the maintainer. No build before that.

## Done when

- The reading is on this card, and either the card closes as "already matches" or it names the decision it needs.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2593.
- Dedup, open and closed: `list_datasets synonyms` 1 hit, the parent.
